name: ribbon-row
title: Ribbon actions over a platform TableView, one of them adding a DG.Row
source: N-3: `run: () => df.rows.addNew(null, true)` handed a DG.Row proxy back, and reading its `then` threw; C-7: ribbon actions dropping their promise
notes: N-3 is a type error in u2 v1: a ribbon action's `run` returns a promise or nothing. At run time it breaks nothing — the engine reads a returned value's `then` inside try (Scope.thenable), so the DG.Row handed back is no promise and no error; add-row fails it again if that guard goes
